causalRelationship.counterfactual: Removing the heads or opening a slot end removes the corresponding retention constraint.

causalRelationship.effect: Handle closure corresponds to jaw opening.
causalRelationship.counterfactual: Pure translation without that pivot does not produce the same opposed motion.
